parameters.gold: σ Daily transition rate E1→E2 and E2→I1 (two-stage latent period)
parameters.extracted: σ Daily rate of progression through exposed stages (E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁). Paper assumes known; implies mean incubation period d_L = 2/σ.

parameters.gold: γ Daily transition rate I1→I2 and I2→R (two-stage infectious period)
parameters.extracted: γ Daily rate of progression through infectious stages (I₁→I₂ and I₂→R). Paper assumes known; implies mean infectious period d_I = 2/γ.

parameters: N Total population size for the season (England). Used in force of infection λ(t)=β I(t)/N.
δt Discrete time step length (a quarter of a day).
β Transmission rate parameter in force of infection λ(t)=β I(t)/N (rate at which new infections occur given a contact).
p_ICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection (used in observational model; not a transmission flow in the SEIR system).
μ_ICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time in observational model).
σ²_ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time in observational model).
η Negative binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts (observational model).
λ(t) Force of infection at time t, assuming homogeneous mixing; I_tot is total infectious (I₁+I₂).
I_tot Total infectious individuals at time t.
β Transmission rate in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N (homogeneous mixing)

observations: Missed 4 compartment(s), 6 flow(s), 1 parameter(s) from gold standard.
Hallucinated 5 compartment(s), 0 flow(s), 9 parameter(s) not in gold standard.
